code: SBC 301-2018 (Saudi Building Code - Loading and Forces)
edition_used: SBC 301-AR-18 (Arabic provisions, printed Jun 2019), 206 PDF pages; printed page 1 = PDF page 16
note: Index of chapters and the wind sections we use, with printed page numbers. Titles are our English translation. The Arabic AR edition refers to the English SBC 301-CR for maps, figures and tables (e.g. wind speed map 26.5.1.1, force coefficients 29.4.1).
